get.description: Returns the plugin's enabled flag and, for each supported league (nfl, ncaa, nhl, mlb), the array of tracked teams with their IDs, names, logos, next event and configured sequences.

post.description: Replaces the stored configuration, persists it to plugin.fpp-gameday.json and starts, stops or wakes the polling threads to match. Sequence names are given without the .fseq extension.

400.description: Invalid JSON in the request body

get.description: Returns the current game state for every tracked team: opponent, scores, period, clock and game status (pre, in, post). Polled by the GameDay Status page.

200.description: Live status for all tracked teams

post.summary: Force a refresh for one tracked team
post.description: Immediately re-queries ESPN for the given team instead of waiting for the next poll interval, and updates the stored state.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the team within that league's tracked list

400.description: Unknown league or index out of range
